svg.text: This 90-acre ranch, located on a Bighorn sheep winter range, was critically overgrazed by

text.font-family: ManualKit Helvetica, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Helvetica, Nimbus Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: domestic sheep. The result, seen in 1965 was a drastic die off of Bighorn sheep following a

text.font-family: ManualKit Helvetica, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Helvetica, Nimbus Sans, sans-serif
ManualKit Helvetica, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Helvetica, Nimbus Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: The ranch was purchased and cleared of debris and fenced by the Fish & Wildlife Branch to

text.font-family: ManualKit Helvetica, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Helvetica, Nimbus Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: remove grazing by domestic cattle and sheep and facilitate the recovery of the Bighorn

text.font-family: ManualKit Helvetica, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Helvetica, Nimbus Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: sheep. This area is also used by Mule Deer, White-tailed Deer, and Elk.
